background_story: Ira was a majestic tuna who roamed the vast expanse of the Pacific Ocean. Born in the warm waters of the equatorial currents, he grew strong and swift, feeding on the abundant schools of smaller fish. Ira's name was whispered in awe by the other sea creatures, who respected his size and strength. But what set him apart was his unique ability to navigate the ocean's depths with uncanny precision, always finding the most bountiful feeding grounds. Ira's legend grew as he led schools of fish to the hidden treasures of the sea, earning him the title of 'Toona King.' His wisdom and leadership were sought by all, from the wise old sea turtles to the playful dolphins, and his name became synonymous with the ocean's power and majesty.
